title: “Amazing, They All Lean Left” – Analyzing the Political Temperaments of Current LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Administering Moral Foundations Theory assessments, 12 established political ideology scales (including the Pew Ideology Scale, ANES scales, and Right-Wing Authoritarianism), and a custom index of current political controversies to measure the liberal versus conservative leanings of various LLMs.
